mainText: Rackspace Spot customers face a reported service shutdown on December eighth following its security breach. Confirm the provider’s notice directly. If your business uses Spot, identify workloads, retrieve data, plan migration and test recovery. Cloud owners should also verify credential rotation. No customer deployment or regional compromise was confirmed. Earlier N-able reporting was already covered, so it is not presented as fresh news. Today’s priority is one practical question: does any production service or supplier depend on Spot? Regional and vendor coverage was incomplete.
